title: As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate he
question:
As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate her nationality and the name of the race to which he/she first joined.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: full name refers to forename+surname; Youngest racer = MAX(dob)

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    d.XCL_038 || ' ' || d.XCL_039 AS full_name,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    r.XCL_069 AS race_name
FROM 
    drivers d
JOIN 
    results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
JOIN 
    races r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
WHERE 
    d.XCL_034 = (
        SELECT 
            XCL_034 
        FROM 
            drivers 
        ORDER BY 
            XCL_040 DESC 
        LIMIT 1
    )
ORDER BY 
    r.XCL_070 ASC
LIMIT 1
